name: AI Usage
tagline: Self-hosted AI quota and credit dashboard with adaptive collection
description:
A self-hosted quota dashboard and JSON API for AI provider accounts. Collectors read Google Antigravity, OpenCode Go, Codex, OneProvider, OpenRouter and Google Cloud billing data; every observation is stored in SQLite; and a React dashboard plus HTTP and MCP APIs expose remaining quota, reset times and API credit balances.

The scheduler backs off from 10 minutes to 6 hours when nothing changes, schedules checks around known reset times, and tracks state per account so one provider does not force a refresh of every other provider. The deployment also includes a public read-only view, per-account history charts, hidden-provider filtering, a Plasma 5 panel widget, and Docker Compose packaging.
purpose: To see remaining quota and API credit across several AI providers in one place without repeatedly polling every provider or exposing credentials.
strengths: Collects quota and credit data from six provider sources, including Google Cloud billing exports
Adapts refresh intervals from 10 minutes to 6 hours and schedules around known resets
Schedules each account independently and serves cached data while refreshing in the background
Stores every successful observation in SQLite with per-account and per-quota history charts
Pools quota bars by type and shows the average time remaining
Ships a public read-only view, an MCP endpoint and a native Plasma 5 panel widget
Keeps provider files read-only except for atomic Codex token rotation
limitations: Provider collectors depend on undocumented or provider-specific endpoints and can break
Requires local credential files plus a reverse proxy for authentication; the app has no built-in login
The public view exposes masked account labels and quota data unless providers are hidden
Google Cloud credit estimates depend on delayed BigQuery billing exports
No license file is present in the repository yet
installation:
git clone https://github.com/chrisb09/ai_usage.git
cd ai_usage
cp .env.example .env
mkdir -p data secrets/opencode secrets/opencode-data secrets/codex
# Populate the credential directories and set AI_USAGE_UID / AI_USAGE_GID
docker compose up -d --build

# Open http://127.0.0.1:7694
